messages.subject: Re: 5-a-side on Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
James — are you in for the 5-a-side at Coram's Fields Thursday 7pm? We're a man short after Dev pulled his hamstring. Let me know and I'll add you to the WhatsApp.

Cheers
Marcus

(Sorry if this is the wrong James — got two in my contacts!)
